name: Hand fan BREEZI
summary: The BREEZI handheld fan is a practical gadget for summer that provides a refreshing breeze where you need it most. You can use it in your hand or place it on your desk, making it useful whether you are at home, at wor...
descriptionLong: The BREEZI handheld fan is a practical gadget for summer that provides a refreshing breeze where you need it most. You can use it in your hand or place it on your desk, making it useful whether you are at home, at work or on the move. Equipped with three cooling modes, it allows you to easily adjust the intensity of the fan to your own preference. Thanks to its 400 mAh battery, it runs for up to 1.5 hours without being plugged in and takes only about 60 minutes to fully charge via USB-C. The lightweight and handy design means that it will fit into a bag or backpack, becoming a reliable companion on hot days. In addition, the fan can be branded, making it an interesting advertising gadget for summer promotional campaigns.
